finalText:
Root cause was in `pricing.js`: flat coupons (stored in USD) were subtracted *after* currency conversion, so the discount was being applied in the wrong currency. 

For example, $10 off a $100 EUR order was calculating as `(100 × 0.9) - 10 = 80` when it should be `(100 - 10) × 0.9 = 81`.

Fixed by subtracting the flat coupon from the USD subtotal before converting. Percentage coupons were already correct since percentages are currency-agnostic. All 5 tests pass now.
